summary: Iteration 6 retest: Both fixes from iteration 5 are verified. Admin login UI now POSTs /api/login, stores JWT in localStorage.auth_token, and hard-navigates to /admin where the Admin Dashboard renders (Total Products: 39). The 4 products that previously referenced the broken Unsplash URL (1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0) now point at the working fallbacks: Marc Pro Original / Marc Pro Reusable Electrodes -> 1571019613454-1cb2f99b2d8b; Squid Go Control Unit / Squid Go Body Part Systems -> 1640101942798-34d181efc234. Regression: /api/products still returns 39 products with Incrediwear Knee Sleeve = 25 variants, Hampton Adams 2-Pack = 10, Clinic Roll = 10. /api/files/ar360/products/* image proxy returns 200 with image/* for all 9 locally-hosted images. 16/16 pytest cases pass.

issues: Cosmetic: Google Fonts CSS returns a font MIME type causing 'OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion' console warnings. Default fonts render fine. Pre-existing from iteration 5.

passed_tests: RETEST admin login UI: POST /api/login -> 200, GET /api/user -> 200, localStorage['auth_token'] populated, page navigated to /admin, Admin Dashboard visible (Total Products 39).
RETEST broken image fix: zero /api/products entries contain '1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0'; all 4 affected products use the new stock fallback URLs.
REGRESSION: Incrediwear Knee Sleeve has 25 variants; Hampton Adams 2-Pack has 10; Hampton Adams Clinic Roll has 10.
REGRESSION: 9/9 /api/files/ar360/products/* URLs return 200 with image/* content-type.
pytest test_ar360_catalog.py: 16/16 passed (visibility filters, categories, featured, image proxy, admin login, variant integrity).
critical_code_review_comments: admin-login-page.tsx uses window.location.assign for a hard navigation - this is pragmatic but bypasses SPA routing. Long-term, prefer syncing the React Query cache (already done in use-auth) plus wouter navigate so the dashboard can be revisited without a full page load.

Hardcoded Unsplash fallback URLs remain a fragility risk - a single image going 404 at Unsplash breaks multiple product cards. Consider bundling a local placeholder under /api/files for full resilience.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (admin login + image fallback render)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 blockers are all resolved. Admin login hard-navigates to /admin via window.location.assign after POST /api/login; token persisted as localStorage.auth_token. Catalog has 39 products, variants intact, image proxy healthy. Only open cosmetic item is the Google Fonts OTS warning (non-blocking).
rca_of_the_issue: Admin login fix root cause: after loginMutation the Wouter navigate() happened before ProtectedRoute's React Query cache observed the new /api/user data, so it re-routed to /auth. The applied fix (window.location.assign('/admin')) forces a fresh page load with the JWT already in localStorage, sidestepping the hydration race. Broken image fix: the stale Unsplash photo ID was rewritten at the import script and via direct DB update to two working stock IDs per category.
